authority_model: GitHub stores programme coordination and durable evidence.
DocPlane stores current page content and state.
/api/v1/changes and page history provide publication history; they are the only authority for what was published.
Prose reports are NOT authoritative counts. Any number in a chat message, commit body or issue comment is a derived claim and must be re-derivable from receipts.

No frozen original 'pages requiring movement' denominator exists. Issue #44 began without one. Any denominator in use is a RETROSPECTIVE classification and must be labelled as such; it must never be presented as the original programme estimate.
The live API gates remain the real mutation authority. The publication-lane file records coordination only and grants nothing.
